findings.body: The schema and Swagger now accept `AskRequest.origin`, but the unchanged `ChatController` discards `parsed.data.origin` when invoking `ChatService.ask` in both the regular route (lines 38–48) and streaming route (lines 84–94). Thus saved-view, pin, and choice continuations remain indistinguishable after validation. MP-ASK-CHOICE must extend the service/controller path and test both routes.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-CHOICE must forward `origin` through both chat routes

findings.body: This exported schema has no non-test consumer: pin controllers parse only request schemas and return `PinResponseDto` responses without this validation. Its new test therefore validates a disconnected production seam rather than the actual wire contract. The adjacent Swagger metadata test already checks the real response DTO, so remove `pinStatusSchema` and its hollow test while retaining the DTO enum contract.
findings.title: Simpler: remove the test-only `pinStatusSchema` → test the response DTO directly
